verdict.rationale: Folk's first-party docs describe registrable webhooks: you specify a URL and subscribe to folk events. Deliveries carry a `webhook-signature` header, follow the Standard Webhooks specification, and include concrete events such as `person_enrichment.finished`. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, a documented full event catalog and retry/delivery-guarantee details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When you create a webhook, you specify a URL and subscribe to events that occur on folk.
folk's webhook system adheres to the standard webhooks specification
`webhook-signature`: The signature used to verify the authenticity of the webhook delivery.
subscribe a webhook to the `person_enrichment.finished` event
